subject: Staffing mutual-action plan + procurement checkpoint (exceptions request)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightPath Recruiting <ops@brightpath.com>, Julia Park <julia.park@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Staffing mutual-action plan + procurement checkpoint (exceptions request)

Team —

Ahead of the leadership QBR on Friday I want to lock the hiring slate we present to the execs and capture any freeze-exception asks. Attach is a working spreadsheet (Q3_hiring_priorities_v2.xlsx) with Req IDs, priority tier, estimated start date, and business justification. High-level asks: 

- Approve 3 frontload reqs for inference runtime (REQ-462, REQ-465, REQ-470) to hit product OKRs for latency and throughput. These are tied to our Optimize roadmap.
- Backfill 2 critical CS0 roles that are revenue-facing (REQ-441, REQ-442).
- Request one-time freeze exception for a senior SRE (REQ-399) that is on the margin but will unblock a multi-region rollout.

Julia / BrightPath: can you confirm your procurement timeline for the Nimbus SOW and whether we can get a PO by 8/25? If procurement slips past the QBR we should mark that as a dependency in the presentation.

Please reply with: approve / defer / deny for each req number by EOD Wednesday. If you have a blocking question, call me — I want to avoid last-minute surprises in the deck.

Thanks,

Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Product Operations, Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com | (415) 555-0189

Attachments: Q3_hiring_priorities_v2.xlsx, Nimbus_SOW_v1.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightPath Recruiting <ops@brightpath.com>, Julia Park <julia.park@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staffing mutual-action plan + procurement checkpoint (exceptions request)

Thanks Sean — quick responses inline for the sheet: 

- REQ-462 (Inference infra engineer): APPROVE. This maps directly to the Q3 throughput OKR; please prioritize hiring funnel/outreach.
- REQ-465 (Model Ops engineer): APPROVE with caveat — we should take a tighter bar on quantization experience. Add that to the job spec.
- REQ-470 (Runtime performance SWE): DEFER for one cycle unless we can secure cadence-of-deliverables from the team (need sprint plan).
- REQ-441 / REQ-442 (CS0 backfills): APPROVE both — revenue impact is clear.
- REQ-399 (Senior SRE freeze exception): REQUEST MORE INFO — need cost delta and impact if we instead hire two mid-level SREs.

I also want the deck to show: hiring cadence (interview -> offer -> start) estimates, and which reqs are contingent on third-party contracting.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Growth & GTM Operations
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightPath Recruiting <ops@brightpath.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staffing mutual-action plan + procurement checkpoint (exceptions request)

Looping in headcount constraints from Finance: we have a partially approved headcount pool for Q3, but it is earmarked to product-facing roles first. That reduces our available new FTEs by two unless we can reclassify a role as revenue-generating.

Regarding REQ-399 (Senior SRE): Finance will consider a freeze exception if we can demonstrate 6-month runway benefits and measurable SLO recovery improvements. Please add a short ROI bulleted section to the sheet.

Also, small ask for the deck: include a single slide showing how each approved req maps to an OKR (one-liner per req). That makes the prioritization defensible during QBR.

Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Finance Partnerships
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
From: Julia Park <julia.park@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightPath Recruiting <ops@brightpath.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staffing mutual-action plan + procurement checkpoint (exceptions request)

Hi Sean / team —

Thanks for the heads-up. Procurement note: Nimbus legal has returned a clean SOW (attached). We can issue a PO as soon as Redwood counters the NDA annex and signs the SOW; our internal approvals will take 48–72 hours after signature. If you need a guaranteed PO by 8/25, we need the signed SOW by 8/23 at the latest.

Also: for any freeze-exception approvals that create a hire before a PO is in place, Nimbus can provide a short-term credit hold but will need a formal DocuSign agreement (I included the DocuSign link in related_links).

Happy to jump on a 20-min call if that helps.

Julia Park
Senior Procurement Manager, Nimbus Analytics
julia.park@nimbus-analytics.com
Phone: (206) 555-0132

Attachment: Nimbus_SOW_v1.pdf
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Julia Park <julia.park@nimbus-analytics.com>, BrightPath Recruiting <ops@brightpath.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staffing mutual-action plan + procurement checkpoint (exceptions request)

Thanks all — quick summary and action items to close before Friday:

1) Approved now: REQ-462, REQ-465 (with quantization spec), REQ-441, REQ-442.
2) Deferred: REQ-470 pending sprint deliverables; Sean to confirm by Monday (8/23).
3) REQ-399 freeze-exception: provide ROI bullets and cost comparison by EOD Thursday — Grace flagged finance constraints; I will add cost/benefit and run 2-option scenario (senior SRE vs two mid-level).
4) Procurement: Julia to issue PO if SOW signed by 8/23; Redwood to return signed SOW by COB 8/22. Sean to coordinate with legal.

I've added a slide link to the shared spreadsheet for the one-liner OKR mapping and updated the req statuses in the attached Q3_hiring_priorities_v2.xlsx. Please mark final approvals in the sheet so I can lock the QBR deck. If anyone needs a live sync, I'm available 11–12 PT tomorrow.
